scripts.deploy: npm run version:bump && npm run lint && npm run build && git add -A -- . ":(exclude)**/*.bak.*" ":(exclude)**/*.backup.*" ":(exclude).next/**" ":(exclude)out/**" && git commit -m "Bump version and deploy site" && git push origin main && sleep 5 && gh run watch $(gh run list --workflow deploy-github-pages.yml --branch main --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId') --exit-status
scripts.deploy:watch: gh run watch $(gh run list --workflow deploy-github-pages.yml --branch main --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId') --exit-status
